skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and evaluate methods of symmetric encryption, authentication, and key exchange using key distribution centers.
Evaluate methods of public key encryption, public key cryptosystems, key management, and public key infrastructure (PKI).
Evaluate hash functions and digital signature schemes.
Understand and evaluate digital signature schemes and their applications.
Understand and evaluate cryptographic algorithms including classical substitution and transposition ciphers, stream ciphers, block ciphers, and elliptic curve cryptography.
Identify and evaluate information security threats and countermeasures.
Understand and apply risk management principles in information security.
Develop critical thinking skills to solve problems related to cryptography and information security.
Develop research skills to investigate and analyze cryptographic and information security issues.
Work effectively in teams to solve complex problems in cryptography and information security.
Demonstrate the ability to learn independently and take responsibility for personal development.
Use Python for cryptographic algorithm implementation and analysis.
Use Wireshark for network traffic analysis and security assessment.
Use NordLocker for secure file storage and management.
Use AxCrypt for secure file sharing and encryption.
Use FolderLock for secure folder protection and access control.
Implement and analyze Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) algorithms.
